quarterly_data.signal: NEC is one of the core member companies and investors (with Sony Group, SoftBank and Honda Motor) of Noetra Corp., which launched full-scale R&D of a Japan-developed multimodal foundation model for AI-enabled robots and physical AI. Noetra has received investments from a total of 44 companies and organizations; in collaboration with NVIDIA it plans to build AI computing infrastructure equipped with approximately 27,500 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, with construction scheduled to begin in April 2027 and operations expected to begin in June 2028; it aims to build a reasoning foundation model in phases from fiscal 2026, an omni-modal foundation model by fiscal 2028 and 'Real-world Native AI' looking ahead to fiscal 2030. NEC President and CEO Takayuki Morita: NEC will contribute to the development of Noetra's domestically produced multimodal foundation models and, building on it, accelerate the development and deployment of specialized AI models, including for physical AI.
